action_items: Fix header detection in parse_paste(): current has_header logic treats any first line containing words like 'existing' as CSV header; require stronger header signal (e.g., multiple columns and known header tokens) before skipping first line.
After fix, retest the failing inline natural-language case and full 8-case parser set.
If environment is restored, run live Matrix UI integration smoke against real backend URL.
critical_code_review_comments: parse_paste() has a false-positive header heuristic causing data loss for natural one-line inputs that include 'new/existing' wording.

Publish guardrails are present by source: accepts CREATE/UPDATE only, validates row customer_type, rejects duplicate category+customer_type keys, and preserves rollback/history fields (inserted_ids/superseded_ids/rejected + rollback restore).
Affiliate/gift-card cap separation is implemented: affiliate uses maximum_cashback_amount payout cap; gift-card continues maximum_eligible_amount spend cap behavior.

rca of the issue: Repro: call parse_paste('3% Cashback on Beauty and Personal Care (Existing Users)', 'existing'). Expected one parsed row; actual []. Root cause: has_header=true when first line contains token 'existing', so parser treats the only line as header and starts data loop from lines[1:], producing zero output. Mitigation: tighten header detection (require delimiter-based multi-column structure and explicit column-name patterns) before skipping first row.
